messages:
Ana (CSM): quick weekly check-in for Lumenix private/VPC — region-by-region health and KMS update. Can folks drop short bullets? :wave:
Samir (SRE): us-west1: uptime 99.97%, median gen latency 82ms (+10ms wk), error rate 0.4% with a 8-min spike at ~03:12 UTC due to an S3 egress flap. eu-central1: 99.99%, latency 95ms, error 0.1%. ap-southeast1: 99.2% — saw KMS/HSM handshake failures last night, ~12m total.
Vikram (ML): usage trend for Lumenix: weekly tokens +18% vs prior, embeddings calls +30%. Spend nozzle is in us-west1. They haven't enabled recommended prefix caching from Optimize yet.
Ana (CSM): @Samir — can you paste the KMS error snippet Lumenix shared? They reported ERR_HSM_CONN_REFUSED in app logs.
Samir (SRE): sure — from their container logs (sanitized):
```
2026-04-01T02:47:19Z lumenix-app-1 ERROR KMSClient: handshake failed: errno=111, ERR_HSM_CONN_REFUSED
2026-04-01T02:47:19Z lumenix-app-1 WARN retrying key fetch (attempt 2)
2026-04-01T02:54:31Z lumenix-app-1 ERROR KMSClient: tls: certificate verify failed: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
```
Samir (SRE): our side shows the HSM endpoint responded but with TLS handshake aborts; timing aligns with customer's scheduled rotation window.
Vikram (ML): that TLS cert error explains the client-side refusal. If cert chain invalid, runtime falls back and you see increased retries -> latency + error bump.
Joel (CSE): I pinged Lumenix infra lead; they confirmed they started a cert rotation that didn't update intermediate chain. They plan re-issue + deploy tomorrow 04/02 01:00 UTC.
Ana (CSM): flagged for remediation window. Renewal touchpoint in 3 months — if KMS instability persists, mark as medium renewal risk.
Samir (SRE): action items: 1) Lumenix to re-issue HSM cert with proper chain (owner: lumenix-infra). 2) Redwood to provide temporary bypass: enable cached key fallback for 6h on us-west1/prod (owner: Samir). 3) CSE to validate post-rotate connectivity and run health-check script (owner: Joel). 4) Ops to watch latency and error SLOs for 48h after change (owner: Vikram).
Vikram (ML): quick health-check command for them to run after rotation:
```
# validate TLS chain to HSM endpoint
openssl s_client -connect hsm.lumenix.internal:443 -showcerts | sed -n '1,200p'
# test KMS sign (dev key)
# curl -s -X POST https://kms.lumenix/api/v1/test-sign -d '{"key":"dev-key"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: lumenix-key-rotation at 1765500000 (04/02T01:00:00Z) :white_check_mark:
Ana (CSM): great — Joel, once you validate, drop a quick thread update. Samir, please create a short runbook snippet we can attach to the customer ticket describing fallback cache steps.
Joel (CSE): will validate after rotation and post results here. I'll also capture the intermediate cert requirement and add to onboarding checklist.
Samir (SRE): noted. I'll draft the runbook and post it by EOD PST.
Ana (CSM): thanks team. I'll update the account health doc and flag medium renewal risk until we see 48h of stable metrics. Next sync if status isn't green by 04/03. :eyes:
